name: What is the difference between a self-contained fountain and a custom-built water feature?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a self-contained fountain and a custom-built water feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: A self-contained fountain is a pre-fabricated unit with an integrated reservoir, pump, and all necessary components within a single structure. They are generally simpler and quicker to install. Custom-built water features, conversely, are designed and constructed specifically for a site, allowing for unique shapes, sizes, and integration into the landscape. These often involve more extensive excavation, plumbing, and electrical work, offering greater design flexibility and impact.
acceptedAnswer.description: Self-contained fountains are pre-fabricated units with integrated reservoirs, while custom-built features are uniquely designed for a site, offering more design flexibility.
